confidence_notes: I ran two web searches. One was for the RBA rate and one was for Brno prices. The Brno prices came from crowdsourced cost-of-living sites (MyLifeElsewhere, and Traveltables, which was last updated in 2023). They gave restaurant meal, cappuccino and beer figures. They gave no cocktail price and no restaurant wine price. Cocktail and wine-by-the-glass are estimated from the local beer price, at roughly 2.5x and 2x. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge. I did not check any booking pages or listings. The RBA search result gave 0.6720 for 18 November 2026, but I did not open the RBA page itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Brno is the second city of the Czech Republic. I based the estimates on its price levels relative to Prague, and I set accommodation somewhat below Prague's. Other mid-sized Central European university cities have similar prices.
